llmJudgeRequirements.description: Store uses `persist` with `createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage)` and persists only token state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: persist uses createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage) correctly, but partialize persists both token AND hasHydrated, not only token state

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Store state includes `hasHydrated` `token` `profileStatus` `profileName` and hydration setter action
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Store has hasHydrated, token, and a hydration action, but lacks profileStatus and profileName fields; instead uses isLoadingProfile/displayName

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Login action performs `POST` request to auth login endpoint and writes returned token into store
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Login performs POST to https://dummyjson.com/auth/login and writes returned accessToken/token into store via set({ token })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Profile fetch request sends `Authorization` bearer header built from persisted token
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: fetchProfile sends Authorization: Bearer header using the token parameter passed in

llmJudgeRequirements.description: onRehydrateStorage sets hydrated flag in success and error paths and reloads profile when token exists
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No onRehydrateStorage callback is defined in persist options; hydration is handled via a manual hydrate() action instead, which is not the onRehydrateStorage lifecycle hook
evidence: no onRehydrateStorage key present in persist options

llmJudgeRequirements.description: UI renders hydration loading branch when `hasHydrated` is false
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: UI renders a branch when !hasHydrated, displaying loading or session-loaded text

llmJudgeRequirements.description: UI renders profile loading branch when token exists and `profileStatus` is loading
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: UI does render an isLoadingProfile branch, but it is not conditioned on token existence; the profile loading indicator appears for any authenticated user regardless of token check
evidence: no explicit token check before profile loading branch
